web.title: Who can get a Pensioner Concession Card - Services Australia
web.description:
# Who can get a card
## Eligible payments
- [Parenting Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/parenting-payment) single.

Your Parenting Payment single ends when your youngest child turns 14. You can keep your card for 12 weeks after your Parenting Payment ends.
